archetypes.name: dyn-role-registry
archetypes.rationale: Registry wiring spans many role-specific dispatch consumers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new external defaults registry and resolver usage across dispatch sites. Confirm each role uses the correct resolver kind and that code-review, plan-review, decompose, voter, and scout defaults remain isolated. Pay particular attention to availability gating and no-fallback policy differences between code-review and plan-review flows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
